note: The ten public games' own text and the site's published human median, which a score is normalised against. Read once from the site's public manifest and score endpoints; the games themselves come from the harness repository.

games.description: Sort colored liquids into tubes so each contains only one color. Pour between tubes strategically to complete all levels.
games.controls:
- Arrow Left/Right: Navigate tubes
- Space: Select tube to pour
- Z: Undo last move
- Enter: Start game
- R: Restart

games.description: Physics-based puzzle game. Launch birds from a slingshot to destroy structures and eliminate pigs. Each bird type has unique abilities.
games.controls:
- Arrow Keys: Adjust aim
- Space: Launch bird
- Z: Activate special ability
- Enter: Start game
- R: Restart

games.description: Top-down tactical shooter. Navigate procedural levels, use cover, manage ammo, and eliminate all enemies to progress.
games.controls:
- WASD: Move
- Arrow Keys: Shoot direction
- Space: Dash/Dodge roll
- Z: Swap weapon
- Shift: Walk slowly
- Enter: Start game
- Esc: Pause
- R: Restart

games.description: Fly through an endless lab with your bullet-powered jetpack. Dodge zappers, missiles, and lasers while collecting coins.
games.controls:
- Space/Arrow Up: Activate Jetpack (Fly Up)
- ESC: Pause/Unpause
- Enter: Start Game
- R: Restart
- Z: Activate special ability

games.description: Collect all cheese to unlock the exit. Avoid patrolling cats and complete all levels to win.
games.controls:
- Arrow Left/Right: Move
- Arrow Up: Jump
- Enter: Start game
- Esc: Pause
- R: Restart

games.description: Guide a boy through a dark, puzzle-filled world. Overcome traps and platforming challenges to reach the final checkpoint.
games.controls:
- Arrow Left/Right: Move
- Arrow Up/Space: Jump
- Z: Interact with objects
- Enter: Start game
- R: Restart

games.description: Top-down tactical shooter. Eliminate enemies, collect ammo, and use cover strategically. Manage health and ammunition to reach extraction.
games.controls:
- Arrow Keys: Move
- Z: Fire weapon
- Space: Sprint
- Shift: Take cover/crouch
- Enter: Start game
- Esc: Pause
- R: Restart

games.description: Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them. Create chain reactions for bonus points. Clear all bubbles before time runs out.
games.controls:
- Arrow Left/Right: Rotate shooter
- Space: Fire bubble
- Z: Swap current bubble with next
- Enter: Start game
- R: Restart

games.description: Action platformer with boss battles. Defeat bosses to gain their weapons, master tight platforming, and conquer the final fortress.
games.controls:
- Arrow Left/Right: Move
- Arrow Up/Down: Aim up/down
- Z: Jump
- Space: Shoot
- Shift: Cycle weapons
- Enter: Start game
- Esc: Pause
- R: Restart

games.description: Escape a haunted mansion while evading a terrifying monster. Navigate 6 levels, find keys, solve puzzles, and hide to survive.
games.controls:
- Arrow Keys: Move
- Shift: Toggle sprint
- Space: Interact with doors, items, hiding spots
- Z: Toggle flashlight
- Enter: Start game
- Esc: Pause
- R: Restart
